how_it_works.title: How subscriptions work
how_it_works.lead: Get the products you buy regularly delivered on your schedule, at a lower price. You stay in control: skip, change or cancel any time before the cut-off.

choose.title: Choose how often
choose.text: Pick Subscribe & Save on the product page and choose a delivery frequency. Your first order ships as usual.

remind.title: We remind you first
remind.text: Before each delivery we email you the items, the date and the highest price you can be charged.

deliver.title: We deliver and charge
deliver.text: The order is placed on the date you chose and charged to the card saved at checkout, with your subscription discount.

savings.title: Savings
items: The discount is shown on the product page before you subscribe.
Some products save more when they are delivered more often.
The discount applies to every delivery for as long as the subscription is active.

prices.title: Prices
items: Each delivery is priced on its order date, minus your discount.
You are never charged more than the price in your reminder.
If the price rises by more than 5%, we ask you to review the delivery before we order it.

changes.title: Skip, pause or change
items: Skip a delivery, pause, or change the quantity, frequency or next date in Account > Subscriptions.
Changes made before the cut-off, one day before the order date, apply to the next delivery.
Order now if you need the items sooner.

payment.title: Payment
items: We charge the card you saved at checkout. You can switch cards at any time.
The payment is authorized when the order is placed and charged when it ships.
If a payment fails, we retry and email you before the subscription is paused.

cancel.title: Cancel any time
items: Cancel in one step in Account > Subscriptions. No calls and no fees.
Deliveries already ordered are not affected.
Once a year we email you a summary of your active subscriptions.

availability.title: Out of stock
items: If an item is unavailable, we let you review the delivery and order the rest.
If you do not respond, that delivery is skipped and the next one goes ahead as planned.

manage.title: Manage your subscriptions
manage.text: See upcoming deliveries and change any subscription in your account.
